text:
morgan: quick catch-up from todays auth sync. proposal: gateway handles coarse RBAC + issues compact signed claim header; services keep fine-grained checks. thoughts?

sarah: agree. gateway normalizes authn -> claim: sub, actor_type, org, scope_kind, scope_ref, roles, iat, exp. services verify signature and trust these fields for fast-path.

kevin: worry: revocation and drift. recommend short TTL (60s) + revoke pubsub for immediate evict. collect mismatch metrics during rollout.

jas: for background jobs, use actor_type=job and a separate signing path. also need delegation flags for cross-project calls with delegation_depth limit.

elena: KMS ops: HMAC signing with kid header, services cache verifiers locally and refresh keys periodically. rotate sign keys weekly, keep verifier window > TTL. document emergency revoke playbook.

sarah: header example (compact):
X-RW-Authz: v1|kid=k1|cid=clm123|sub=svc-9|actor=service|org=o12|single:proj-4|roles=writer|iat=1714301200|exp=1714301260|del=0|ddepth=0

morgan: scope kinds: single, all, set-ref (where scope_ref is small id resolved by scope-service). avoid embedding long project lists.

kevin: rollout steps: emit header behind flag -> services parse+metric but keep legacy checks -> flip gateway allow for low-risk endpoints -> iterate. track ClaimVerifyLatency, GatewayAllow_ServiceDeny, ServiceAllow_GatewayDeny, ScopeServiceCacheHit.

jas: security notes: gateway must canonicalize actor mapping; do not accept client-provided actor fields. replay handled by short exp and unique claim ids.

elena: infra-bot, create checklist and dashboards pls.

infra-bot: created: [feature-flag gateway-claims-v1, header-whitelist X-RW-Authz, local-verifier-lib v0.1, scope-service endpoint, pubsub rw-claim-revoke, dashboards for ClaimVerifyLatency & GatewayAllow_ServiceDeny].

morgan: thanks. I'll draft RFC with header schema, verifier lib, revocation pubsub, scope-service contract, rollout checklist, and runbook. will ping for review in #eng-security.
